design_rationale:
[1] WHY THIS IS A GOOD TEST. The customer asks for one thing: extend his Crestline Trip Credit (credit_holdings.e17a398d-37a3-48b0-bca0-d8eabf46e927, CX2073519264) before it runs out on 2026-11-09. The extension-term rule states that 'For a credit whose extension fee is not waived, the new expiry date from an extension is recorded only after the credit carries an extension fee entry dated on the day of the extension.'; the extension-fee rule in turn states 'The extension fee is not worked out until every call-center redemption on the credit that owes a telephone fee carries its own linked telephone fee entry.' The ledger shows the 2026-09-24 call-center redemption for Renata Hollis's Toronto ticket without its telephone fee. So the agent must discover a two-hop chain from records alone (a missing fee entry behind a missing fee entry), book the overdue telephone fee (5 factors), hand the customer an extension fee (5 factors) whose fee-count rate depends on that newly booked entry, and only then extend by a month count built from 5 factors. Difficulty is policy reading, ledger reconciliation across three products and arithmetic; there is exactly one tool per write.
[2] SCOPE SNAPSHOT (task 1 of 2). Occupied by task 0: credit_ext_reinstated_validity, credit_ext_reinstatement_fee, tools reinstate_credit_8e2d0d7d and pay_credit_reinstatement_fee_177d2025. Claimed by task 1: credit_ext_telephone_fee (charge_credit_phone_fee_f43f310b, agent, state_due), credit_ext_extension_fee (pay_credit_extension_fee_5a6cc7fd, owner=user) and credit_ext_extension_term (extend_credit_f94665bb, agent). No policy or tool is left idle; the two scopes are disjoint and together cover all five extended policies.
[3] DRAW (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=2, factor_counts=[5, 5, 5]; each of the three computations takes 5 factors.
[4] PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root credit_ext_extension_term (agent). Edge A: root -> credit_ext_extension_fee, kind state_gate, gate credit_ledger.fee_type, form state, sentence (root's own rule) 'For a credit whose extension fee is not waived, the new expiry date from an extension is recorded only after the credit carries an extension fee entry dated on the day of the extension.' Four-point test: connective 'only after', affirmative direction (a record that is 'recorded only after' what it rests on, as an extensions desk would say it), rewritable as 'is not recorded until the credit carries ...' with the same scope; waits on a record state (an extension fee entry on the credit's ledger); no tool, id or code token; hard strength, scoped to non-waived fees exactly as condition. Exactly one write of the difficulty books an extension_fee entry: pay_credit_extension_fee_5a6cc7fd (owner=user, the customer's card payment). Unresolved at frozen_time: the only service-fee entry is credit_ledger.df3b7cc0-c9ff-44f1-8b94-0cfc74140db7 (phone_redemption_fee), extension_count 0, Summit Silver does not waive. Edge B: credit_ext_extension_fee -> credit_ext_telephone_fee, kind value_input, gate xf_recent_fee_entries, form state, sentence (the extension-fee rule's own) 'The extension fee is not worked out until every call-center redemption on the credit that owes a telephone fee carries its own linked telephone fee entry.' Four-point test: connective 'not ... until', negated direction (a charge 'is not worked out until' what it waits for stands); waits on a record state (a linked telephone fee entry for every owing call-center redemption); no code token; scope 'that owes a telephone fee' excludes waived tiers and instruments not redeemable online, matching condition. Exactly one write books telephone fee entries: charge_credit_phone_fee_f43f310b (agent). Unresolved: credit_ledger.da32db7c-3233-4618-a2e1-5aa3698bb49a is a call_center redemption and no fee entry's related_entry_id points at it (the only one, df3b7cc0-c9ff-44f1-8b94-0cfc74140db7, points at f1fe00c5-ebd4-48db-b309-f6276d2318fa). Derivations: sentence B + ledger + the telephone-fee rule ('A redemption through the reservations call center is charged a telephone fee as a separate fee entry linked to that redemption ...') -> book the telephone fee for da32db7c-3233-4618-a2e1-5aa3698bb49a; sentence A + ledger + the extension-fee rule -> the customer pays the extension fee. Topological order: telephone fee (step 10), extension fee (step 12), extension (step 14); a chain, so no parallel pair. Deletion sensitivity: skipping step 10 moves the scored extension fee from 14.25 to 19.00 (fee-count 1, rate 0.80); skipping step 12 leaves the terminal ledger without the extension fee entry. The charter carries both directions of prerequisite sentence (task 0's fee: 'fixed only after'; edge B: 'not worked out until'; edge A: 'recorded only after'). user_scenario never mentions a telephone fee, an extension fee or how the September trip was booked; the tools validate nothing.
[5] BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Step 10 and step 12 subject credit_service_fee: governing credit_redemption_rules (no gate on fees -> policy_scope), credit_extension (gate fee_on_live_credit: 'A credit fee entry is charged only on a credit whose status is active or expired.' - status active), credit_reinstatement (policy_scope). The telephone fee's base exemptions are inherited: Trip Credit online_redemption_permitted true, Summit Silver credit_service_fees_waived false, so the fee is owed. Step 14 subject credit_extend: governing credit_extension, gate extension_window (time): anchor credit_holdings.expiry_date 2026-11-09, duration variants.extension_request_window_days_before_expiry = 60, relation not_before, inclusive; the window opens 2026-09-10 and closes on 2026-11-09; 2026-10-15 is inside (2026-09-09 would be too early, 2026-11-10 would need reinstatement). Prose conditions: extension_permitted true, extension_count 0 < max_extensions 1.
[6] OVERWRITES. credit_ext_telephone_fee supersedes credit_redemption_rules 'A redemption through the reservations call center carries phone_redemption_fee per ticket, charged as a separate fee entry linked to the redemption' (base on this world: 25.00; extended: 10.27). credit_ext_extension_fee supersedes credit_extension 'The extension_fee is charged as a separate fee entry at the time of the extension' (base 75.00; extended 14.25). credit_ext_extension_term supersedes credit_extension 'An active credit's expiry_date may be extended by extension_months calendar months' and 'The new expiry_date is the old expiry_date plus extension_months calendar months' (base 6 months / 2027-05-09; extended 8 / 2027-07-09). Every other clause (window, count limit, waivers, fee on a live credit, face value and beneficiary unchanged by an extension) stays inherited.
[7] FACTOR CARD - credit_ext_telephone_fee (result 10.27, all-baseline 25.00). telephone_fee_basis (method, history): value paid toward ticket 4192617764015 = 148.60 in [100,250) -> lesser of 25 and 16 percent (23.776) (baseline flat -> 10.80); near-miss: the June call-center redemption (286.15) is already billed and would give the flat 25. telephone_fee_member_rate (parameter, cross-difficulty loyalty, multi-source: tier from loyalty_holdings AND flight accruals in 6 months from loyalty_activity - the task's genuine multi-source factor): Silver with 3 -> 0.75 (baseline -> 13.69). telephone_fee_billing_delay_rate (parameter, date): 21 days -> 0.80 (baseline -> 12.84); counting both ends (22) would land on 0.60. telephone_fee_route_rate (parameter, cross ticket): ORD-YYZ short-haul -> 0.80 (baseline -> 12.84). telephone_fee_card_spend_rate (parameter, cross loyalty history): 2 card accruals in 3 months -> 0.90 (baseline -> 11.41); near-misses loyalty_activity.392697ce-51ab-403e-9a3a-e06fd94d4db7 (card accrual 2026-07-05, 3 whole months back) and loyalty_activity.69130679-f281-4909-af72-f86f68c1181e (hotel partner) - counting either gives 3 and rate 0.80 (fee 9.13).
[8] FACTOR CARD - credit_ext_extension_fee (result 14.25, all-baseline 75.00). extension_fee_basis (method, history): ledger remaining 110.85 < 150 -> 40 percent = 44.34 (baseline flat -> 24.10); near-miss: face value 858.00 gives the flat 75. extension_fee_count_rate (parameter, history, the value_input gate): 2 service-fee entries in 12 months once step 10 lands -> 0.60 (baseline -> 23.74; without step 10: 1 entry, 0.80, 19.00). extension_fee_member_rate (parameter, cross-difficulty loyalty; tier and qualifying dollars come from one membership record): Silver 5120.00 >= 4500 -> 0.85 (baseline -> 16.76). extension_fee_source_fare_rate (parameter, cross ticket): source Main Flexible -> 0.70 (baseline -> 20.35). extension_fee_cardmember_rate (parameter, cross companion): co-branded card anniversary certificate companion_holdings.81b92e93-918a-4ad1-b45e-fd5ffd20dac3, no pass -> 0.90 (baseline -> 15.83).
[9] FACTOR CARD - credit_ext_extension_term (result 8, all-baseline 6). tenured_member_term (parameter, cross-difficulty loyalty; tier and enrolment date come from one membership record, so it is not counted as multi-source): middle tier (any other Gold member, or a Silver member enrolled 60+ whole months) - Silver, 90 months >= 60 -> 7 (baseline 6 -> 7). extension_prior_use_months (parameter, history): 3 redemptions -> +2 (baseline -> 6). extension_disruption_months (parameter, cross ticket history): one controllable record ticket_disruptions.5bf733ec-009f-4fc9-9d73-d602b0231048 -> +1 (baseline -> 7); near-miss ticket_disruptions.6bc58010-436c-4692-92f0-1e790990987a is uncontrollable - counting it gives +2 and 9. extension_source_route_months (parameter, cross ticket): ORD-CUN short-haul -> +1 (baseline -> 7). extension_request_closeness (method, date): 25 days to expiry in (15,30] -> x 3/4 rounded down (baseline 'as they stand' -> 11).
[10] BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Target: credit_holdings.e17a398d-37a3-48b0-bca0-d8eabf46e927, the customer's only credit. The telephone fee links by related_entry_id to credit_ledger.da32db7c-3233-4618-a2e1-5aa3698bb49a (the unbilled call-center redemption); the June fee df3b7cc0-c9ff-44f1-8b94-0cfc74140db7 already settles f1fe00c5-ebd4-48db-b309-f6276d2318fa; the online redemption c6bff203-96ad-49ac-9a79-a3ea4988ea7e owes nothing. The extension fee and the extension attach to the credit by credit_id. Cross-product rows: loyalty_holdings.4496f5a0-3149-4282-98a0-1b03b50f13cb, eighteen loyalty_activity rows (7 flight accruals, their 7 triggered mqd accruals, 3 card, 1 hotel), six tickets (March 2026 Premium Economy ea03e316-d4d7-4598-b21f-ada73ec31638, source a7879fa2-1be7-47a9-8b0a-cd456486580e, flown 763f0a46-42c7-40c3-b2d5-78f087ac6bd0, 922063bc-6680-497f-9aed-be91d9e83aba, df7a18dc-4d6d-464c-a384-18ccffaaa69d, Renata's ticketed a751606f-9954-4ef7-bda2-a2513c2ab8ba), two disruption records, one companion certificate.
[11] WORLD ROWS AND AUTOMATIC CLAUSES. Every row feeds a factor or a prerequisite (see cards). The credit is active and inside its window, so no expiry or write-off falls due before 2026-11-09; Renata's ticket is ticketed for 2026-10-22 and unaffected; the companion certificate is active and unused; no other obligation is lit besides the unbilled telephone fee, which this task carries (state_due). No stale cache: remaining_value 110.85 equals the ledger.
[12] PERSONA. Desmond Hollis, methodical band director; volunteers only the goal (extend the credit expiring November 9, nothing planned before then) and its origin (took it instead of a refund for a Cancun trip); gives mobile number, date of birth, email, ZIP, credit number, Summit number, his trips and the co-branded card only when asked; accepts 'something else to settle first' after a one-sentence explanation; pays exactly the quoted amount when handed a payment; leaves the length of the extension to the agent; repeats the new date and ends. No figures, no extra asks; his last reaction answers the last gold action (the extension).
[13] REACHABILITY WALK. He asks to extend; mobile 3125552744 locates, date of birth 1977-11-03 verifies. The credit lookup shows an active Trip Credit within its window; the published extension rule sends the agent to the extension fee entry; the fee rule sends it to the telephone fee of the call-center redemption that owes one; the ledger shows the September one, the latest call-center redemption, unbilled. The agent books the telephone fee (receipt with fee entry id), computes and hands over the extension fee (the customer runs the payment; receipt returned in the transcript), then extends (receipt with new expiry 2027-07-09). All at 2026-10-15 15:40 CT, all synchronous; no external event is awaited.
[14] EASY MISTAKES. Extending first (no fee entry behind it); computing the extension fee before the telephone fee (19.00); charging flat fees (25, 75) or the flat 6 months; picking the June redemption for the telephone fee; counting the uncontrollable delay, the out-of-window card accrual or the hotel accrual; using the face value instead of the ledger balance; forgetting the closeness adjustment (11 months).
[15] STANDARD SOLUTION AND VERIFICATION. Reads: find_customers, verify_customer_identity, find_credit_holdings, find_credit_ledger, find_loyalty_holdings, find_loyalty_activity, find_ticket_holdings, find_ticket_disruptions, find_companion_holdings. Writes: charge_credit_phone_fee_f43f310b(credit_id, redemption_entry_id=da32db7c-3233-4618-a2e1-5aa3698bb49a, fee_amount=10.27); the customer's pay_credit_extension_fee_5a6cc7fd(credit_id, fee_amount=14.25); extend_credit_f94665bb(credit_id, extension_months=8). Verification replayed gold with the real tools and evaluated each compute on its handling-time world (check_compute machinery): telephone fee 10.27 (baselines 10.80/13.69/12.84/12.84/11.41, all 25.00); extension fee 14.25 after step 10 (24.10/23.74/16.76/20.35/15.83, all 75.00; 19.00 with step 10 skipped); extension 8 after step 12 (7/6/7/7/11, all 6). Gates: check_extended --task 1 EXTENDED OK; check_task_tools OK; replay_tasks REPLAY OK (15 actions, closure 25/25); check_solvability OK; check_compute COMPUTE OK (history rows 11, branches 50); check_grounding OK; check_cross_fire SCOPE OK.
[16] RULE <-> COMPUTE SWEEP. Forward: every world-reading or choosing binding quotes its sentence in compute_basis. Reverse: telephone-fee sentences on the waiver and online exemption (tp_fee_waived, P online_redemption_permitted), 'the latest call-center redemption' (LATEST with redemption_channel filter), 'the value the credit paid toward the ticket' (SUM by applied_ticket_number), the day count 'from the date of the redemption to the date the telephone fee is booked' (DAYS), and every ladder are claimed; extension-fee sentences on the ledger remaining value (the seven-term SUM), the 12-month fee count, the order and single rounding are claimed; extension-term sentences on the order (sum then closeness), the day count 'from the request date to the credit's expiry date as recorded on the credit' (DAYS(NOW, expiry)) and each ladder are claimed. No window or filter appears in compute that the rule does not state.
[17] SOLVABILITY AND BLIND DRAFT. solvability_contract: step 10 state_due from the unbilled redemption, fee_on_live_credit on credit_id; step 12 fee_on_live_credit plus prior_step 10; step 14 extension_window with frozen_time and its boundary cases. Blind draft from visible context: extension rule -> needs an extension fee entry -> extension-fee rule -> needs every owing call-center redemption billed -> ledger shows 2026-09-24 unbilled -> telephone fee 23.776 x 0.432 = 10.27 -> extension fee 44.34 x 0.3213 = 14.25 -> extension 11 x 3/4 = 8. Same objects, order and values as gold.
[18] REVISIONS. (a) Persona: first draft named the telephone booking fee and the extension fee in its reactions and said the Toronto trip was booked 'over the phone'; both would hint at the prerequisites, so the reactions were made generic ('something else has to be settled', 'an amount for you to pay yourself') and the channel was removed. (b) Seed: flight accrual miles set to 7 miles per dollar of eligible fare, the Summit Silver earning rate. Gates re-run green. ROUND 2 (policy-task audit rework; items from audits/policy_task/flight_credits_and_vouchers/_difficulty.md and 1.md). G-1/T1-F1 (RED): symptom - the tenured-member ladder's fall-through gave tenured Summit Platinum, Diamond and Chairman holders the standard 6 months, less than a tenured Silver (7) or Gold (8) holder. Change: upper_tenured_term_months (8) for any Summit Platinum, Diamond or Chairman member and for a Summit Gold member enrolled 60+ whole months; middle_tenured_term_months (7) for any other Summit Gold member and for a Summit Silver member enrolled 60+ whole months; the standard extension term otherwise. No tier gets less than one below it. This Silver holder (90 months) stays on the middle tier: extension 8, sensitivity 7, all-baseline 6 unchanged. G-3: the telephone-fee rule now says 'A telephone fee is owed only for the latest call-center redemption on the credit, and only while no telephone fee entry is linked to it; an earlier call-center redemption that was left unbilled when a later call-center redemption was made is no longer owed a telephone fee.', and compute adds tp_redemption_entry / tp_already_billed (result 0.00 when the latest call-center redemption already carries a linked telephone fee), so the owing clause, the priced redemption and the extension-fee prerequisite ('every call-center redemption ... that owes a telephone fee') always name the same single redemption; the extension-fee edge condition is aligned. Here the latest call-center redemption da32db7c is unbilled, so the fee stays 10.27. G-2: the extension-fee cardmember rate now decides by EXISTS (any active pass, else any active co-branded card certificate); rate stays 0.90. G-4/T1-O1: each windowed rule now defines its window, e.g. 'A telephone-fee window of the last so many calendar months holds the entries dated fewer than that many whole calendar months before the date the telephone fee is booked, so it rolls back from that date and is not a count of completed calendar months.' and 'An extension-fee window of the last so many calendar months holds the entries dated fewer than that many whole calendar months before the date the extension fee is worked out, ...'. That excludes the complete-calendar-month readings the audit computed (card accruals 3 -> 9.13; fee count 1 -> 19.00): the 2026-07-05 card accrual is 3 whole months back and the 2026-10-15 telephone fee is 0 months back, so 10.27 and 14.25 are the only readings the text allows, and the value_input edge keeps bearing weight. G-8/T1-O4: every flight accrual now carries its triggered loyalty_mqd_accrual, and the March 2026 ORD-FRA Crestline Premium Economy round trip (two coupons, 2205.70 and 2205.69) was added so the 2026 mqd rows (271.58 + 247.63 + 189.40 + 4411.39) sum exactly to qualifying_dollars_ytd 5120.00; its accruals (2026-03-20, 2026-03-28) are 6 whole months back and stay outside the 6-month flight window (count still 3); mile_balance moved to 61915; the January accrual miles were corrected to 951 (135.79 x 7). T1-O2 (G-6), G-5 and G-7 are accepted as observations with no change. T1-O3: multi-source labels corrected above. All scored figures unchanged; gates re-run green.
user_scenario:
You are Desmond Hollis, a high-school band director in Chicago, calling from the school office after rehearsal. You are calm, polite and a little methodical: you like to hear what is going to happen before it happens, and you say "okay, go ahead" when you are satisfied. You hold a Crestline trip credit that you took instead of a refund when you called off a Cancun trip last fall. You open by explaining that the credit runs out on November 9, that you have nothing planned before then, and that you would like it extended so you do not lose what is left on it. You are not asking to book anything, cash it out or change anything else about it.

You answer questions one at a time rather than reciting everything. Your mobile number is 3125552744 and your date of birth is 1977-11-03; if a third detail is needed, your email is d.hollis@northgatemail.com and your billing ZIP code is 60614. The credit number, which you have on a note in your wallet, is CX2073519264, and your Summit number is 2193360581. If the agent asks how you have used the credit, you remember flying to Minneapolis on it in January and to Orlando in June, and booking your wife Renata's Toronto trip in September; you think there is a bit over a hundred dollars left but tell the agent to go by their records. If asked, you do hold the Crestline co-branded card, and a companion certificate came with it in March that you have not used.

If the agent tells you that something else has to be settled on the credit before the extension, you ask them to explain it in a sentence and then accept it without argument. When the agent tells you there is an amount for you to pay yourself and hands you the payment step, you pay it by card for exactly the amount the agent quotes, and you read back the receipt number if they ask. You never suggest an amount or a length of extension yourself; if the agent asks how long you would like, you say you will take whatever the extension gives you. Once the agent tells you the credit has been extended and gives you the new expiry date, you repeat the date back to be sure you have it, thank them and end the call.
